s.how: Fold 400g crab meat with 2 tbsp mayo, 1 egg, 1 tsp Dijon, celery salt, paprika and 50g breadcrumbs. Shape into 8 cakes and chill 30 minutes. Pan-fry in 40g butter until golden and serve with lemon.

s.note: the sailing trip that ends badly
s.how: Chop 400g cooked prawns and fold with 3 tbsp mayo, lemon juice, a finely diced celery stick and chives. Butter the cut sides of 4 hot dog buns and toast. Pile the prawns in.

m.how: Slice 1kg potatoes thin, layer with 300ml cream and garlic and bake at 160C for 75 minutes. Pan-roast 4 chicken breasts. Add 150ml white wine, 1 tbsp Dijon and tarragon to the pan, then 150ml cream. Serve with 300g green beans.

w.note: every wedding they crash has one
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 200g self-raising flour. Bake in two tins at 165C for 30 minutes. Heat 3 whites and 150g sugar to 70C, whip, then beat in 250g butter. Layer with raspberry jam and cut into fingers.

d.note: the toast at every reception they crash
d.how: Chill a 750ml bottle of sparkling wine for three hours. For each drink, shake 30ml gin, 15ml lemon juice and 15ml sugar syrup with ice. Strain into a flute and top slowly with about 90ml sparkling wine. Add a long twist of lemon peel and raise them high while someone gives a speech.
